summary: Former fire lookout tower in Scott County, Virginia, listed as gone. The sources say nothing more about its history or the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source describes what remains on the ridge or whether the site is open to visitors.

evidence.supports: Lookout listed under Virginia, Scott County
Mapcarta has a Buckner Ridge Lookout Tower point in Scott County
evidence.quote: Buckner Ridge Lookout Tower is a tower in Scott

evidence.supports: Fort Blackmore about 2.5 miles south of the tower
evidence.quote: Fort Blackmore is situated 2½ miles south of Buckner Ridge Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts page has only the name and Scott County; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives the status and coordinates. The Mapcarta entry is a map label (OpenStreetMap tower feature), not evidence of a structure. No source found gives a build date, staffing, fire history or removal date. The story is about 100 words, under the 120-word target, rather than padded. Story could be revisited if a Forest Service, Scott County or newspaper source turns up.
